description: Versioned component-impact map bridging repository paths (including non-package inputs) into CI check sets. See docs/plans/complete/agent-platform/01-workspace-and-ci.md. Unknown paths, missing merge bases, empty diffs and selection failures all resolve to the full check set; this map never produces a no-op success.

core.note: Rust workspace checks plus CLI/MCP contracts and packaged consumer smoke; dependent adapter/extension contract tests join here once present

cli.note: CLI/MCP tests and native packaging smoke

launcher.note: Launcher tests and three-platform packed-install/native archive smoke

release.note: Release tooling tests run in the Check jobs via the root test task

eval.note: Frozen evaluation harness tests run in the Check jobs via the root test task

schemas.note: Producer validation plus consumer contract tests and schema-copy checks (smoke verifies bundled copies)

adapter.note: Agent adapter protocol host and Cline adapter; their node --test suites run in the Check jobs via the package test tasks

extension.note: Reserved home; no package exists yet, so until it ships this maps to the broad checks

docs.note: Applicable formatting plus example consistency; no link checker or skill-discovery validator ships yet

ci.note: Workflows and impact-map changes run broad relevant checks

root.note: Lockfiles, toolchains, root configs and shared Rust paths default to the full suite until a narrower rule is proven

default.note: Unknown paths and unlisted components select the full suite
